anime_multiverse.race.saiyan.description: A proud warrior race whose Ki is its magicule. Saiyans start strong, grow stronger with every hard fight, and rise through four stages: Saiyan, Primal Saiyan, Divine Saiyan and Autonomous Martial God. Choosing this race makes you a Saiyan (Ki, Battle Power, Zenkai and the Saiyan techniques).
